verses.en: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
verses.pt: Veio sobre mim a mão do Senhor; e ele me levou no Espírito do Senhor, e me pôs no meio do vale que estava cheio de ossos;
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
verses.en_bbe: The hand of the Lord had been on me, and he took me out in the spirit of the Lord and put me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones;

verses.en: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.pt: e me fez andar ao redor deles. E eis que eram muito numerosos sobre a face do vale; e eis que estavam sequíssimos.
verses.en_web: He caused me to pass by them all around: and behold, there were very many in the open valley; and behold, they were very dry.
verses.en_bbe: And he made me go past them round about: and I saw that there was a very great number of them on the face of the wide valley, and they were very dry.

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
verses.pt: Ele me perguntou: Filho do homem, poderão viver estes ossos? Respondi: Senhor Deus, tu o sabes.
verses.en_web: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, Son of man, is it possible for these bones to come to life? And I made answer, and said, It is for you to say, O Lord.

verses.en: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.pt: Então me disse: Profetiza sobre estes ossos, e dize-lhes: Ossos secos, ouvi a palavra do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.
verses.en_bbe: And again he said to me, Be a prophet to these bones, and say to them, O you dry bones, give ear to the word of the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus a estes ossos: Eis que vou fazer entrar em vós o fôlego da vida, e vivereis.
verses.en_web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said to these bones: See, I will make breath come into you so that you may come to life;

verses.en: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.pt: E porei nervos sobre vós, e farei crescer carne sobre vós, e sobre vos estenderei pele, e porei em vós o fôlego da vida, e vivereis. Então sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And I will put muscles on you and make flesh come on you, and put skin over you, and breath into you, so that you may have life; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

verses.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verses.pt: Profetizei, pois, como se me deu ordem. Ora enquanto eu profetizava, houve um ruído; e eis que se fez um rebuliço, e os ossos se achegaram, osso ao seu osso.
verses.en_web: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.en_bbe: So I gave the word as I was ordered: and at my words there was a shaking of the earth, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

verses.en: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
verses.pt: E olhei, e eis que vieram nervos sobre eles, e cresceu a carne, e estendeu-se a pele sobre eles por cima; mas não havia neles fôlego.
verses.en_web: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
verses.en_bbe: And looking I saw that there were muscles on them and flesh came up, and they were covered with skin: but there was no breath in them.

verses.en: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
verses.pt: Então ele me disse: Profetiza ao fôlego da vida, profetiza, ó filho do homem, e dize ao fôlego da vida: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Vem dos quatro ventos, ó fôlego da vida, e assopra sobre estes mortos, para que vivam.
verses.en_web: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, Be a prophet to the wind, be a prophet, son of man, and say to the wind, The Lord has said: Come from the four winds, O wind, breathing on these dead so that they may come to life.

verses.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
verses.pt: Profetizei, pois, como ele me ordenara; então o fôlego da vida entrou neles e viveram, e se puseram em pé, um exército grande em extremo.
verses.en_web: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
verses.en_bbe: And I gave the word at his orders, and breath came into them, and they came to life and got up on their feet, a very great army.

verses.en: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
verses.pt: Então me disse: Filho do homem, estes ossos são toda a casa de Israel. Eis que eles dizem: Os nossos ossos secaram-se, e pereceu a nossa esperança; estamos de todo cortados.
verses.en_web: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to me, Son of man, these bones are all the children of Israel: and see, they are saying, Our bones have become dry our hope is gone, we are cut off completely.

verses.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.pt: Portanto profetiza, e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Eis que eu vos abrirei as vossas sepulturas, sim, das vossas sepulturas vos farei sair, ó povo meu, e vos trarei à terra de Israel.
verses.en_web: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause be a prophet to them, and say, This is what the Lord has said: See, I am opening the resting-places of your dead, and I will make you come up out of your resting-places, O my people; and I will take you into the land of Israel.

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
verses.pt: E quando eu vos abrir as sepulturas, e delas vos fizer sair, ó povo meu, sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves, and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be certain that I am the Lord by my opening the resting-places of your dead and making you come up out of your resting-places, O my people.

verses.en: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it, and performed it, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E porei em vós o meu Espírito, e vivereis, e vos porei na vossa terra; e sabereis que eu, o Senhor, o falei e o cumpri, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”
verses.en_bbe: And I will put my spirit in you, so that you may come to life, and I will give you a rest in your land: and you will be certain that I the Lord have said it and have done it, says the Lord.

verses.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.pt: A palavra do Senhor veio a mim, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:
verses.pt: Tu, pois, ó filho do homem, toma um pau, e escreve nele: Por Judá e pelos filhos de Israel, seus companheiros. Depois toma outro pau, e escreve nele: Por José, vara de Efraim, e por toda a casa de Israel, seus companheiros;
verses.en_web: “You, son of man, take one stick, and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’
verses.en_bbe: And you, son of man, take one stick, writing on it, For Judah and for the children of Israel who are in his company: then take another stick, writing on it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the children of Israel who are in his company:

verses.en: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
verses.pt: e ajunta um ao outro, para que se unam, e se tornem um só na tua mão.
verses.en_web: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.
verses.en_bbe: Then, joining them one to another, make them one stick, so that they may be one in your hand.

verses.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
verses.pt: E quando te falarem os filhos do teu povo, dizendo: Porventura não nos declararás o que queres dizer com estas coisas?
verses.en_web: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’
verses.en_bbe: And when the children of your people say to you, Will you not make clear to us what these things have to do with us?

verses.en: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
verses.pt: Tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Eis que eu tomarei a vara de José, que esteve na mão de Efraim, e as das tribos de Israel, suas companheiras, e lhes ajuntarei a vara de Judá, e farei delas uma só vara, e elas se farão uma só na minha mão.
verses.en_web: tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.
verses.en_bbe: Then say to them, This is what the Lord has said: See, I am taking the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel who are in his company; and I will put it on the stick of Judah and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

verses.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
verses.pt: E os paus, sobre que houveres escrito, estarão na tua mão, perante os olhos deles.
verses.en_web: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’
verses.en_bbe: And the sticks with your writing on them will be in your hand before their eyes.

verses.en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
verses.pt: Dize-lhes pois: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Eis que eu tomarei os filhos de Israel dentre as nações para onde eles foram, e os congregarei de todos os lados, e os introduzirei na sua terra;
verses.en_web: Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.
verses.en_bbe: And say to them, These are the words of the Lord: See, I am taking the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will get them together on every side, and take them into their land:

verses.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
verses.pt: e deles farei uma nação na terra, nos montes de Israel, e um rei será rei de todos eles; e nunca mais serão duas nações, nem de maneira alguma se dividirão para o futuro em dois reinos;
verses.en_web: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king will be king over them all: and they will no longer be two nations, and will no longer be parted into two kingdoms:

verses.en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.pt: nem se contaminarão mais com os seus ídolos, nem com as suas abominações, nem com qualquer uma das suas transgressões; mas eu os livrarei de todas as suas apostasias com que pecaram, e os purificarei. Assim eles serão o meu povo, e eu serei o seu Deus.
verses.en_web: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places, in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.en_bbe: And they will no longer make themselves unclean with their images or with their hated things or with any of their sins: but I will give them salvation from all their turning away in which they have done evil, and will make them clean; and they will be to me a people, and I will be to them a God.

verses.en: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
verses.pt: Também meu servo Davi reinará sobre eles, e todos eles terão um pastor só; andarão nos meus juízos, e guardarão os meus estatutos, e os observarão.
verses.en_web: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances, and observe my statutes, and do them.
verses.en_bbe: And my servant David will be king over them; and they will all have one keeper: and they will be guided by my orders and will keep my rules and do them.

verses.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.
verses.pt: Ainda habitarão na terra que dei a meu servo Jacó, na qual habitaram vossos pais; nela habitarão, eles e seus filhos, e os filhos de seus filhos, para sempre; e Davi, meu servo, será seu príncipe eternamente.
verses.en_web: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince for ever.
verses.en_bbe: And they will be living in the land which I gave to Jacob, my servant, in which your fathers were living; and they will go on living there, they and their children and their children's children, for ever: and David, my servant, will be their ruler for ever.

verses.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.pt: Farei com eles um pacto de paz, que será um pacto perpétuo. E os estabelecerei, e os multiplicarei, e porei o meu santuário no meio deles para sempre.
verses.en_web: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make an agreement of peace with them: it will be an eternal agreement with them: and I will have mercy on them and make their numbers great, and will put my holy place among them for ever.

verses.en: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.pt: Meu tabernáculo permanecerá com eles; e eu serei o seu Deus e eles serão o meu povo.
verses.en_web: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.en_bbe: And my House will be over them; and I will be to them a God, and they will be to me a people.

verses.en: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.pt: E as nações saberão que eu sou o Senhor que santifico a Israel, quando estiver o meu santuário no meio deles para sempre.
verses.en_web: The nations will know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And the nations will be certain that I who make Israel holy am the Lord, when my holy place is among them for ever.
